headline: UEMOA: 12th annual review of community reforms makes stop in Senegal
summary: The technical phase of the 12th annual review of UEMOA community reforms opened in Dakar. The review assesses 149 regulatory texts and the execution of three community programmes and projects.
why: UEMOA is the West African Economic and Monetary Union, which shares the CFA franc and a common central bank. Its reform reviews shape regulatory and investment conditions across member states.
original_headline: UEMOA : la 12ᵉ revue annuelle des réformes communautaires fait étape au Sénégal
